Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: 4-row by 4-column animation sprite sheet, 16 frames. Output square 1536x1536, each equal cell 384x384. Solid uniform #FF00FF chroma key background, NO grid lines or text.

CRITICAL animation quality: each row must be ONE master drawing copied 4 times with ONLY the specific tiny hand/eye change described. Identical camera, head scale, posture, body outline, feet, furniture and prop scale across the 4 frames. NO breathing displacement, no head/body bobbing, no changes in tabletop or chair geometry. Same compact minimal desk in every row, no computer monitor for these activities. Full desk, chair and feet in frame. Flat three-quarter front view, head and face unobstructed, subject about 330px tall, centered, foot baseline y=354. All objects within 20px cell safe margin. Deliberate clean anime cel shading matching reference.
ROW1 THOUGHT: seated at desk, left elbow on desk, left cheek resting on gloved palm, right hand rests on desk. Closed mouth neutral thoughtful face. Frames: gaze slightly up; gaze a tiny amount farther up; gaze slightly up; same as first. Only pupil movement, absolutely no body or desk displacement.
ROW2 READ BOOK: seated at same desk, open book flat on tabletop, left hand holds book, right index finger tracks a line. Frames: finger at start; finger 2px farther right at eventual 192px display scale; finger 4px farther right; finger back at start. Eyes look down at book. ALL remaining artwork repeated unchanged. No page turning.
ROW3 INSPECT IMAGE: seated at same desk, one paper photograph with a simple landscape lies on tabletop, left hand holds paper, right hand holds round magnifying glass above it. Frames: magnifier at center; 1px right; 2px right; center. These tiny distances at final192px display. Do not enlarge or distort face through glass. Head and furniture fixed.
ROW4 WRITE ON PAPER: seated at same desk, left hand steadies paper, right hand holds a pen touching paper. Frames: pen at start; moves 1px diagonally; moves 2px diagonally; back to start. Distances at final192px display. Only fingers/pen move, no elbow shoulder head movement.
No waving, jumping, smiling changes, bouncing, squash or stretch, no floating effects, no readable words, no changes in hair length, head size or pose between frames. Preserve consistent identity, identical body and furniture within each row. Use a flat perfectly solid MAGENTA background in every gap including under desk.
